vi: Thiết kế firewall rule VPC-level với priority (0-65535), direction (INGRESS/EGRESS), và target tag, thay vì security group attach lên instance như AWS.
Xác định first-match-wins theo priority khi nhiều firewall rule xung đột, và tính toán rule nào thắng.
Cấu hình Cloud NAT (SNAT phân tán) cho phép instance private egress ra internet với IP tĩnh allow-list-able mà không có inbound path.
Gắn Cloud Router làm control-plane anchor cho Cloud NAT, quản lý subnet selection, port allocation, và egress IP strategy.
Tối ưu hóa egress cost bằng cách giới hạn port/protocol qua firewall rule, sử dụng IP tĩnh thay dynamic, và cleanup ngay sau khi hoàn thành lab.
en: Design VPC-level firewall rules with priority (0-65535), direction (INGRESS/EGRESS), and target tags, replacing the per-instance security group model of AWS.
Determine first-match-wins by priority when multiple firewall rules conflict and calculate which rule takes precedence.
Configure Cloud NAT (distributed SNAT) to let private instances egress to the internet under an allow-listable static IP without an inbound path.
Attach a Cloud Router as the control-plane anchor for Cloud NAT, managing subnet selection, port allocation, and egress IP strategy.
Optimize egress costs by restricting ports/protocols via firewall rules, using static IPs instead of dynamic ones, and cleaning up immediately after the lab.
